compare.exclude_fields_reason: Cross-language RNG (Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++) — intent triple diverges by design (monsters.rs:22-29 / inflight-briefing §9).
compare.step_exclude_fields_reason: sts2-rs-gvn: per-step shape lock — Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++ roll different intent_damage each turn, so damage-derived fields (hp/block/is_alive/powers) diverge. Game-over arrives at different rounds across languages, so /round and the player energy fields (which freeze post-game-over) are also excluded. Only purely structural shape (type tag, top-level keys, enemy id/max_hp, pile counts, player/max_hp) is byte-locked across the 10-turn walk.
